proposal.reason: Main functional change is communicator configuration control: new config fields are validated, defaulted, overridden from env, stored on comm, and synchronized across ranks (graphUsageMode, nChannelsPerNetPeer, maxP2pPeers, plus accepted-but-not-yet-active nvlinkCentricSched/numRmaCtx). Enqueue also needs review because strongstream/graph-capture behavior is changed to respect graphUsageMode, affecting acquire/release and capture mixing semantics. Device-topology needs review because remote-net P2P channel estimation and maxP2pPeers-based channel-per-peer computation were changed in topology path/channel logic.
